question: Find and open the PDF of Attention Is All You Need. For the base Transformer, identify the number of encoder layers and the number of attention heads per encoder self-attention layer. Use the multiply tool to calculate their product. Support both inputs with short quotes and PDF page numbers.
answer: The base Transformer has 6 encoder layers and 8 attention heads per encoder self-attention layer. Their product is 48.
